indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX blob_retirements_pkey ON SCHEMA.blob_retirements USING btree (generation)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX generations_operation_key ON SCHEMA.generations USING btree (operation)
CREATE INDEX generations_path ON SCHEMA.generations USING btree (path, created_at, id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX generations_pkey ON SCHEMA.generations USING btree (id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX one_active_path ON SCHEMA.operations USING btree (path) WHERE (NOT closed)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX operations_pkey ON SCHEMA.operations USING btree (id)
CREATE INDEX receipts_operation ON SCHEMA.receipts USING btree (operation, created_at, id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX receipts_pkey ON SCHEMA.receipts USING btree (id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX refs_pkey ON SCHEMA.refs USING btree (path)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX replication_identities_address_key ON SCHEMA.replication_identities USING btree (address)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX replication_identities_dn_key ON SCHEMA.replication_identities USING btree (dn)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX replication_identities_pkey ON SCHEMA.replication_identities USING btree (name)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX replication_identities_role_name_key ON SCHEMA.replication_identities USING btree (role_name)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX replication_identities_slot_key ON SCHEMA.replication_identities USING btree (slot)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX schema_version_pkey ON SCHEMA.schema_version USING btree (singleton)

triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER immutable_retirement BEFORE DELETE OR UPDATE ON SCHEMA.blob_retirements FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION guard_retirement()
CREATE TRIGGER guard_source_pins BEFORE INSERT ON SCHEMA.generations FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION guard_source_pins()
CREATE TRIGGER guard_source_intent BEFORE INSERT ON SCHEMA.operations FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION guard_source_intent()
CREATE TRIGGER immutable_operation BEFORE UPDATE ON SCHEMA.operations FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION guard_operation()
CREATE TRIGGER capture_retirement AFTER UPDATE ON SCHEMA.refs FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION capture_retirement()
CREATE TRIGGER guard_current_ref BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE ON SCHEMA.refs FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION guard_current_ref()
